text: Fed Chair Kevin Warsh declines to signal an October rate decision and reiterates opposition to forward guidance. He describes widespread global monetary tightening despite independent central bank mandates. Fed rates stand at 3.75%-4%; futures price a 72.3% probability of no change at the October 27-28 meeting.

meta.note: October and December rate decisions remain unresolved; market probabilities and analyst forecasts are not policy commitments.

text: A White House official confirms Katie Zacharia is leaving the press secretary position after five days. Trump publicly describes advising her to reconsider the role. Zacharia conducted one briefing and faced scrutiny over her performance and legal credentials. No successor is announced.

meta.note: Departure is confirmed; formal separation terms and successor appointment remain unspecified.
